talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Spiritual Focus
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Divine Strength
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Increases your Strength by 10%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Healing Light
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 12%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Reverence
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Allows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Improved Seals
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 15%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Purifying Power
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by 33%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Divine Favor
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Illumination
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Holy Conduit
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by 40%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Divine Precision
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 8%, and reduces the duration of Silence effects on you by 20%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Infusion of Light
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within 15 sec by 1 sec.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Oath of Light
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 5 min, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 401, your Flash of Light by up to 116, and your Holy Shock by up to 230. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by t

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Consecrated Ground
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Gives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Holy Shock
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 134 Holy damage to an enemy, or 114 healing to an ally.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Boundless Light
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by 30% when cast on allies not affected by your Oath of Light.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Holy Power
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Increases the critical strike healing bonus of your Holy spells by 50%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Light's Vigil
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 335. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Divine Intellect
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Increases your total Intellect by 10%.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Redoubt
talent_and_other_spell_ids.notes: Max rank: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 30%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

talent_and_other_spell_ids.name: Precision

talent_changes.change: Holy Strike: new ability at level 6, instant Holy damage from 50% weapon damage plus a per-rank bonus.
Judgement no longer consumes the active Seal; classic seal twisting removed baseline.
Seal of Fury: new level-10 tank Seal (flat Holy damage per swing, absorb = 50% of it, Judgement taunts at 10 yd).
Consecration baseline at 20 (no longer a Holy talent); full damage only to the first 4 enemies.
Lay on Hands cooldown 20 min (was 1 h). Fire/Frost/Shadow Resistance Aura affect all raid members within 30 yd.
Made baseline: Blessing of Kings, Improved Blessing of Wisdom, Lasting Judgement, Improved Seal of the Crusader Judgement bonus.
Righteous Fury trained at 10 (was 16): +33% all threat, +90% Holy threat.
Removed: Salvation, Mass Salvation, Revoke, Blessing of Light. Judgement of Fury lasts 3 s (was 4).
Spiritual Focus row 1 (5 points); Improved Seals 5 points; Reverence row 2 (2 points); Purifying Power row 2; Divine Favor and Illumination row 3; Holy Conduit moved into Holy row 3.
Voice of Truth removed. New: Oath of Light (row 4), Boundless Light (row 5, +15/30% Holy Shock crit on allies without your Oath).
Divine Precision row 4, 2 points: 4/8% Holy spell hit and -10/20% Silence duration.
Holy Power: +10-50% critical healing bonus of Holy spells (was crit chance).
Light's Vigil: friendly targets only (offensive mode removed).
Holy Shock moved to the 21-point gold medal, cooldown 10 s (was 30 s). Divine Favor became the 16-point medal (moved again at launch).
Divine Intellect moved to Protection row 1; Sacred Duty row 2 (no Stamina; -30/60 s on Divine Shield/Divine Protection/Templar's Bulwark and -5/10 s Forbearance).
Improved Seal of Fury and One-Handed Weapon Specialization removed.
Templar's Bulwark moved to row 3 and is a dispellable Magic effect.
Improved Righteous Fury 3/6/9% damage reduction; Shield Specialization 2 points (15/30% block value, 50/100% chance for 4% max mana).
Swift Judgement now instantly unleashes your active Seal and does not share Judgement's cooldown (was: reset Judgement's cooldown).

New Stoicism (row 5, -10/20% Stun and Charm duration); Holy Shield row 5; Iron Creed 3 points (10/20/30% Holy Strike threat, 2/4/6% DR 6 s); new Shieldsworn (row 7: Holy Strike -4 s CD, strikes with the shield, can block spells 6 s).
Holy Conduit moved to Holy; Sanctified Judgement and Conviction row 2; Conviction 2/4/6% crit for all spells and attacks.
Vindication no longer raises your Attack Power; Unyielding Faith moved to Retribution row 3.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization row 4: +2/4/6% Holy and Physical damage and -7/14/20% threat with a two-hander.
Instrument of Law removed; Champion of the Light 12-60% of Intellect as spell damage and -0.2 to -1.0 s Hammer of Wrath cast.
Vengeance stacks to 5 (was 3) and requires Seal of Command.
New Turn Evil (row 5): Turn Undead -0.5/1.0 s cast, -5/10 s CD, also affects Demons.
Twist of Light removed; Unsealed Wrath is the 31-point talent (requires Repentance): swings store the active Seal for 15 s up to 3; a hit with a different Seal fires them.
Sacred Arbiter: new 16-point medal, Holy Strike +20% and refreshes all Judgements on the target (incl. other Paladins'). Repentance moved to the 21-point medal.
Removed: Improved Retribution Aura, Sanctity Aura. Protection removed: Blessing of Sanctuary, Improved Concentration Aura.

rotations.retribution: Keep a Blessing (Blessing of Kings, Blessing of Might before 20) and a Seal up. Judge Seal of the Crusader first on targets that live a while, then switch to Seal of Command (slow two-hander, low spell power) or Seal of Righteousness (fast weapon, high spell power). Judgement (off the GCD) and Holy Strike on cooldown; Hammer of Justice or Repentance before Judgement with Seal of Command for the bonus vs stunned/incapacitated targets (macro /cast Repentance + /cast Judgement keeps the incapacitate). Hammer of Wrath below 20% (from 44). Exorcism on Undead/Demons (also a 30 yd tag). Consecration only when mana allows (8 s, costs almost twice Judgement + Holy Strike). AoE: Consecration, Holy Wrath vs Undead/Demons from 50. With Unsealed Wrath: let 2-3 Seal of Command copies stack, swap to Seal of Righteousness for one swing, then swap back (Wowhead).
rotations.protection: Righteous Fury and Retribution Aura before the pull (Devotion Aura if another Paladin runs Retribution Aura). Keep Seal of Fury up: its Judgement taunts (10 yd) and adds damage; Judgement on cooldown for threat and to grab loose mobs, Swift Judgement as a second taunt. Consecration as long as mana allows (main AoE threat). Holy Shield (if talented) before Holy Strike with Shieldsworn; Holy Strike on cooldown; Exorcism and Holy Wrath on Undead/Demons; Hammer of Wrath when tanking 0-1 targets. Swap to Seal of Righteousness only when no taunt is needed. Sync Judgement and Holy Strike so the 5-second rule restores mana.
rotations.holy: Flash of Light is the efficient main heal; Holy Light for heavy damage (Infusion of Light crits cut its cast); Holy Shock as an instant emergency/moving heal; Light's Vigil (1.5 s cast, expensive) on an ally before group damage, then Holy Shock on that ally to heal their whole party. Seal of Light while healing, Seal of Righteousness for damage. Questing damage: Seal of Righteousness, Judgement, Holy Strike, Exorcism (Undead/Demons), Holy Shock, Consecration if mana allows.
rotations.mana: Do not refresh the Seal until it is about to run out; skip Judgement/Holy Strike if the next swing kills; turn leftover mana into Holy Light instead of eating (Icy Veins Ret). 5-second rule: casting stops Spirit regen for 5 s, so sync Judgement and Holy Strike and stop casting near the end of a fight (Icy Veins Prot/Holy, Wowhead Prot). Consecration is the big mana sink. Blessing of Wisdom when mana is the limit (Wowhead). Sanctified Judgement and Shield Specialization return mana; Reverence lets 30% of regen continue while casting.
rotations.seals: Seal of Command for slow two-handers or low spell power (about 7 procs per minute regardless of speed, 0.203 SP coefficient after the 0.7 weapon modifier); Seal of Righteousness for fast weapons or high spell power (0.12 SP per hit with a two-hander, 0.10 one-hander). Judge Seal of the Crusader first for its 40 s Holy-damage debuff. Tanks: Seal of Fury (Judgement taunts). Healers: Seal of Light. Judgement no longer consumes the Seal; seal twisting only via Unsealed Wrath (31-point Retribution talent).
rotations.pvp_retribution: Unconfirmed (foreverbattlegrounds, secondary): Hammer of Justice (10 yd) -> Judgement with Seal of Command (doubled on stunned targets) -> Holy Strike; Repentance as a second window; finish with Hammer of Wrath at 30 yd (instant with Champion of the Light 5/5). With Unsealed Wrath swing Seal of Command, swap Seals just before the stun. Blessing of Freedom replaces your other Blessing on that target.

changes_log.change: Beta: Holy Strike weapon damage per rank 25/29/32/36/39/43/46/50%; Retribution Aura updates with caster spell power; Consecration fixes; Righteous Fury Holy threat lowered to 60% (was 90%); Echo of Justice proc chance fixed.
Beta: Redoubt 4-20% block, Holy Shield 30% block; Champion of the Light 20/40/60% Int (healing tooltip was a mistake).

Beta: Retribution Aura uses the Paladin's spell power, Classic base damage, 6% SP ratio; Reckoning 1.5 s internal cooldown; Seal of Fury mana return only with Improved Seal of Fury; mana returns no longer generate threat.

Beta (posted Oct 16): Salvation/Mass Salvation/Revoke replace Blessing of Salvation; Judgement of Righteousness/Fury coefficients fixed; Seal of Righteousness SP double-dip fixed; Consecration 0.042 SP per tick; Righteous Fury Holy threat back to 90%; Seal of Fury rank 3 at 26; Shield Specialization 4% mana; Reckoning stores up to 4 charges; Champion of the Light 10/20/30%.
Paladin class deep dive published (Holy Strike, Seal of Fury, baseline Consecration/Kings, new talents incl. beta-only Voice of Truth/Twist of Light/Instrument of Law).
Racials: Human Ruthless 1% crit (was 2%), Human Spirit 10%; Dwarf Earth Fury removed, Artisan's Precision +1% hit added.

Launch notes (posted Nov 3): Righteous Fury at 10 (+33% threat, +90% Holy); Salvation/Mass Salvation/Revoke/Blessing of Light removed; Judgement of Fury 3 s; Voice of Truth, Improved Seal of Fury, One-Handed Weapon Spec, Instrument of Law, Twist of Light removed; new Oath of Light, Boundless Light, Stoicism, Shieldsworn, Turn Evil; Unsealed Wrath is the Retribution 31-pointer; Vengeance 5 stacks; Templar's Bulwark row 3 and dispellable.
WoW Forever launch (Blizzard dev notes addendum: swing timer bar, PvP scoreboard, no honor floating text at Honor cap).
Hotfix (PvP): Plainsrunning can't be stacked in battleground preparation and is cancelled when carrying a flag.
Hotfix: Cooldown Manager shows crowd-control durations correctly with diminishing returns; The Quick and the Dead Legacy talent fix.

Hotfix: Consecration no longer stops dealing its increased damage after targets inside despawn; Cooldown Manager now shows Seals correctly; invisible wall on the Warsong Gulch Alliance base roof removed; dungeon kill XP +50%.
